about: A self-hosted app for making and sending invoices.

prs.title: UBL invoices pass the European buyer name check
prs.broken: Every UBL invoice broke a European e-invoicing rule because the buyer's legal name was missing, so PEPPOL networks and validators rejected it.
prs.changed: The buyer's legal name is now included, as the seller's already was.
prs.matters: Businesses can send their invoices through e-invoicing networks without rejections.

prs.title: E-invoices include the customer's city and postal code
prs.broken: Invoices exported in the European e-invoice format left out the city and postal code, so validators and some receiving systems rejected them.
prs.changed: The export now writes the city and postal code into their proper fields.
prs.matters: Invoices can be sent to systems that require a full address.
